name: inline-activity-loader
title: Inline Activity Loader
description: A tiny loader that sits inline with text to show an agent is working: 18 CSS figures (orbit, signal, glyph, snake, vortex, a count-up and more) sized in em by default.
label: Generative Loaders by Kasturi Khanke
author: Kasturi Khanke <https://github.com/kasturibuilds>
attribution: Generative Loaders, Copyright (c) 2026 Kasturi Khanke and Generative Loaders contributors. MIT License.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height (a number is pixels). The em default scales with the surrounding text.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback rate (one cycle is 1.2 s at 1).

props.name: label
props.description: Makes it a polite status with this text. Omit it when adjacent text already names the activity.

a11y: With `label`, the loader is a status region (role="status") whose visually hidden content is the label, so screen readers announce it (a Labs addition; upstream only set aria-label).
Without `label` it stays aria-hidden, as upstream: the adjacent text ("Searching the web") names the activity, and a second announcement would repeat it.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the figure stops on a static frame.
The figure draws the same in right-to-left pages (rows and grids keep their timing order).
